# 4 MB flash layout: # Trade-off vs the chassis default (factory + ota_0 + ota_1 + storage):
#   Default:    1152K factory  + 1216K ota_0 + 1216K ota_1 + 448K storage
#   This file:                   1792K ota_0 + 1792K ota_1 + 384K storage
#                                                            (no factory)
# Use this preset when:
#   - app .bin > 1216 KB (typically anything pulling NimBLE / a fat HTTP UI)
#   - 4 MB flash is fixed (most ESP32-C6 SuperMini boards)
#   - you accept losing the "factory partition handoff" rescue layer in
#     exchange for fitting the OTA slots
# Recovery story without factory:
#   - Layer 1 (OTA rollback) still works: bootloader auto-reverts to the
#     previous slot if the new image panics within 60 s of boot
#   - Layer 2 (boot-loop counter / SoftAP recovery) still works: 3 bad
#     boots arms recovery mode
#     and the user OTAs a working image back via Web UI. This works as
#     long as AT LEAST ONE of ota_0/ota_1 still boots into a chassis that
#     can serve the recovery Web UI.
#   - Layer 3 (factory partition handoff) is GONE: if BOTH ota slots are
#     panic-loop bricks
OTA-ONLY variant — no factory rescue pa: you need USB to flash. This is the same risk
